# Erdos #25 - Knowledge Base

## Problem Statement

Let 1 <= n_1 < n_2 < ... be an arbitrary strictly increasing sequence of positive integers, each with an associated residue class a_i modulo n_i. Let A be the set of positive integers m such that for every i, either m < n_i or m is not congruent to a_i modulo n_i. Must the logarithmic density of A exist?
